task_intent: Refine Tessera’s personal music library and games with expressive native interfaces and matching wall experiences.

references.title: Shazam — song search
references.applied: Artwork-led rows with distinct title and artist hierarchy; local search keeps its scope clear.

references.title: Shazam — search in library
references.applied: Keep search next to the library and song-specific details attached to the song. Avoid a second settings popup.

references.title: Apple Human Interface Guidelines — Searching
references.applied: Descriptive scope-specific placeholder, clear search action and explicit no-results feedback.

references.title: Apple — Identify a song using Shazam
references.applied: Keep the identified song's durable identity and history visible; separate recognition from playback and avoid implying that a learned song is currently playing.

references.title: Apple Developer — ShazamKit
references.applied: Explain the distinction between sound fingerprints and audio recordings in a concise, contextual privacy statement. Tessera uses its existing local fingerprint engine.
